A Journey across Canada

横穿加拿大 · 180 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1After a quiz last autumn, Kuang travelled east across the continent to visit a schoolmate in Toronto, a journey of approximately 5,000 kilometres.

2His train started from Vancouver, a city surrounded by mountains. After confirming his baggage was aboard the train, Kuang settled into his seat. Having a gift for communication, he started chatting with another passenger within 5 minutes. Their topics included the Canadian traditions, the Prime Minister, the mixture of ethnic groups and the terrifying waterfall. After a nice buffet at noon, he was pleased to find that the scenery was impressive. He saw beautiful harbours in the distance, wealthy urban areas and a maple forest that covered thousands of acres. He even managed to catch sight of an eagle flying upward over bushes.

3At dawn on a misty morning, Kuang reached Toronto, which is fairly close to the border. There was frost and the broad downtown streets were very quiet. Though it was early, Kuang phoned his schoolmate in a booth nearby at once instead of waiting for him to come. They had a good time together.

横穿加拿大

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1去年秋天的一次小测验结束后，匡向东横穿大陆，去多伦多看望同学。全程大约五千公里。

2他从群山环抱的温哥华坐火车出发。确认行李也上了车，他就在座位上安顿下来。他擅长和人打交道，坐下没到五分钟就和另一位乘客聊了起来。他们聊到加拿大的传统、总理、多元的族群，还有那座气势惊人的大瀑布。中午吃过一顿可口的自助餐后，他高兴地发现沿途风景格外壮观。远处是美丽的港湾，沿途有富庶的城区，还有绵延数千英亩的枫林。他甚至瞥见一只鹰从灌木上方飞过，直向高处飞去。

3匡在一个雾蒙蒙的清晨抵达多伦多。这座城市离边境不太远。地上结着霜，市中心宽阔的街道十分安静。虽然时间还早，他也没等同学自己过来，立刻在附近的电话亭给同学打了电话。两人一起度过了一段愉快的时光。
